viewAboutTaglineOfis: The app that opens, edits and signs documents
viewAboutTaglineFolio: Petition, case and office app for lawyers
viewAboutDescOfis: With Ofis you open, edit and print your UDF, Word, ODT, RTF and PDF documents and sign them with your e-signature card. You check references to statutes and court decisions, find spelling mistakes, have text read aloud and dictate what you want written.
viewAboutDescFolio: With Folio you write your UDF petition, sign it with an e-signature or mobile signature and send it to your case file. You manage your clients, your hearing and deadline calendar, your office’s accounts and your team from the same app.
viewAboutDataOfis: Your data is kept only on your own devices. Ofis has no server that holds your data, and it uses no AI service. When you share live with another office remotely, documents and messages pass encrypted through our relay server; the server cannot see the content and stores nothing.
viewAboutDataFolio: Your data is kept only on your own devices. Folio has no server that holds your data. AI features are optional and stay off unless you turn them on. When you share live with another office remotely, documents and messages pass encrypted through our relay server; the server cannot see the content and stores nothing.
